commands.command:
set -eu
base=/srv/legacy2/temporary-file-symlink-defense
cat > "$base/bin/export" <<'EXPORT_EOF'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu

base=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$(dirname -- "$0")/.." && pwd)

if [ "$#" -ne 1 ] || [ -z "$1" ]; then
    printf 'usage: %s OUTPUT\n' "$0" >&2
    exit 64
fi

destination=$1
destination_dir=$(dirname -- "$destination")
destination_name=$(basename -- "$destination")
temporary=

cleanup() {
    if [ -n "$temporary" ]; then
        rm -f -- "$temporary"
    fi
}
trap cleanup EXIT
trap 'exit 129' HUP
trap 'exit 130' INT
trap 'exit 143' TERM

umask 077
temporary=$(mktemp "$destination_dir/.${destination_name}.tmp.XXXXXX")
cat "$base/invoices.csv" > "$temporary"

# -T makes a symlink-to-directory an ordinary destination entry rather than
# allowing mv to follow it and redirect the completed export into that directory.
mv -fT -- "$temporary" "$destination"
temporary=
EXPORT_EOF
chmod 755 "$base/bin/export"
if [ -L "$base/tmp/export.tmp" ]; then
    rm -f -- "$base/tmp/export.tmp"
fi
sh -n "$base/bin/export"
printf '%s\n' '--- repaired bin/export ---'
sed -n '1,240p' "$base/bin/export"
printf '%s\n' '--- legacy tmp directory after safe cleanup ---'
ls -la "$base/tmp"

commands.command:
set -eu
base=/srv/legacy2/temporary-file-symlink-defense
testdir=$(mktemp -d /tmp/export-verify.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf -- "$testdir"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
source_before=$(sha256sum "$base/invoices.csv" | awk '{print $1}')
protected_before=$(sha256sum "$base/protected.txt" | awk '{print $1}')

"$base/bin/export" "$testdir/normal export.csv"
cmp -s "$base/invoices.csv" "$testdir/normal export.csv"
printf 'normal_export=PASS rows='
wc -l < "$testdir/normal export.csv"

mkdir "$testdir/redirect-target"
printf '%s\n' 'marker-must-remain' > "$testdir/redirect-target/marker"
ln -s "$testdir/redirect-target" "$testdir/symlink-output.csv"
"$base/bin/export" "$testdir/symlink-output.csv"
test ! -L "$testdir/symlink-output.csv"
test -f "$testdir/symlink-output.csv"
cmp -s "$base/invoices.csv" "$testdir/symlink-output.csv"
test "$(cat "$testdir/redirect-target/marker")" = 'marker-must-remain'
test "$(find "$testdir/redirect-target" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 | wc -l)" -eq 1
printf '%s\n' 'preexisting_symlink_redirect=BLOCKED_AND_REPLACED'

pids=
i=1
while [ "$i" -le 40 ]; do
    "$base/bin/export" "$testdir/concurrent-$i.csv" &
    pids="$pids $!"
    i=$((i + 1))
done
for pid in $pids; do
    wait "$pid"
done
i=1
while [ "$i" -le 40 ]; do
    cmp -s "$base/invoices.csv" "$testdir/concurrent-$i.csv"
    i=$((i + 1))
done
count=$(find "$testdir" -maxdepth 1 -type f -name 'concurrent-*.csv' | wc -l)
test "$count" -eq 40
leftovers=$(find "$testdir" -maxdepth 1 -name '.*.tmp.*' | wc -l)
test "$leftovers" -eq 0
printf 'concurrent_exports=PASS count=%s private_temp_leftovers=%s\n' "$count" "$leftovers"

source_after=$(sha256sum "$base/invoices.csv" | awk '{print $1}')
protected_after=$(sha256sum "$base/protected.txt" | awk '{print $1}')
test "$source_before" = "$source_after"
test "$protected_before" = "$protected_after"
printf 'source_sha256=%s\nprotected_sha256=%s\n' "$source_after" "$protected_after"
printf 'legacy_tmp_entries=%s\n' "$(find "$base/tmp" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 | wc -l)"
